title: AdCreativeExtraction
description: Structured features of a single-page ad creative, recoverable from converted text + image captions.

text_elements.description: One entry per distinct text block visible in the creative, in reading order.

text_content.description: Exact verbatim text of this block, preserving line breaks, casing, and symbols like the trademark sign.

semantic_role.description: The single best-fit functional role: badge, headline, subheadline, feature_benefit, body_copy, cta, brand_logo, legal_disclaimer, or price.

visual_assets.description: One entry per non-text visual element (photograph, illustration, diagram, icon, logo mark, background).

asset_type.description: photo, illustration, diagram, icon, logo_mark, or background.

description.description: Natural-language description of what the asset depicts.

depicts_product.description: True if this asset shows the advertised product itself.

message.description: Marketing interpretation inferable from the text alone.

brand_name.description: The advertised brand exactly as written.

primary_value_proposition.description: The core benefit or claim the ad makes.

hook_type.description: Persuasion angle: fact_education, curiosity, social_proof, benefit_led, problem_solution, authority, or urgency.

claimed_benefits.description: Distinct benefits or outcomes the copy claims.

cta_present.description: Whether an explicit call-to-action appears in the text.
